① 查看赛道\n右键旋转视角，中键平移，滚轮缩放；F 显示整条赛道。\n\n②:
1. View the track
Right-drag to orbit, middle-drag to pan, and use the wheel to zoom. F fits the full track.

2. Move an obstacle
Click and release to select it. Then drag the obstacle or its selection ring.
Use the left panel to change spacing, height, heading and color. Turning posts support either passing side.
Standard gates have 3 m center spacing, 3.2 m beams and a 0.1 × 0.1 m beam section.

3. Generate from images
Track diagrams are recognized offline. Ground and aerial photos use the optional AI draft workflow; review before applying.

4. Save and use
Save .otproj to keep an editable project.
Export .trk and import it in VelociDrone: Track Editor → Import Track.
